map.二手车电气系统逐项测试清单，涵盖灯光、雨刮、车窗、空调、音响、充电系统等14项电: Used-car electrical-system test checklist covering 14 electrical functions such as lights, wipers, windows, AC, audio and charging, generating a fault-diagnosis report
map.📖 查看「电器（功能/故障）测试 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Electrical (function / fault) Test User Guide"
map.逐项测试电器功能，选择测试结果（正常/间歇故障/完全故障），系统自动评估电器系统: Test each electrical function and select the result (normal / intermittent fault / complete fault); the system auto-assesses the electrical-system condition
map.购车前对电气系统 14 项功能测试：灯光、雨刮、车窗、空调、音响、充电等。: Before buying, test 14 electrical functions of the system: lights, wipers, windows, AC, audio, charging, etc.
map.结合电池电压与充电电压判断电源系统健康，定位偶发/常发故障。: Combine battery and charging voltage to judge power-system health and locate occasional / constant faults.
map.输出故障诊断报告，区分「确认故障」与「间歇性故障」便于议价。: Output a fault-diagnosis report distinguishing "confirmed fault" from "intermittent fault" for easier bargaining.
map.以「电池电压 12.4V、充电电压 14.2V、空调不制冷、右后窗升降偶发卡顿」: Example: battery 12.4V, charging 14.2V, AC not cooling, right-rear window occasional stutter
map.电池 12.4V 与充电 14.2V 处正常范围，电源系统健康；14 项功能逐项: Battery 12.4V and charging 14.2V are in the normal range, power system healthy; 14 functions ticked one by one, AC not cooling counted as "confirmed fault", right-rear window occasional stutter counted as "intermittent fault". The report summarises fault and intermittent items, giving the diagnosis: power OK, but AC needs repair and the right-rear window motor may be aging. Such clear fault points can be used directly to push price down or demand reconditioning.
map.电池电压和充电电压多少算正常？: What battery and charging voltages are normal?
map.熄火静置电池电压约 12.2~12.8V 为正常，低于 12.0V 可能亏电或老: Static off battery voltage about 12.2~12.8V is normal; below 12.0V may mean undercharge or aging; running charging voltage about 13.8~14.6V is normal alternator output. Abnormal values on either often point to battery or alternator failure. Specific thresholds follow the model manual.
map.间歇性故障为什么单列？: Why is intermittent fault listed separately?
map.间歇性（偶发）故障难以复现、修复成本高且易被掩盖，工具将其与「确认故障」分开统计: Intermittent (occasional) faults are hard to reproduce, costly to fix and easy to hide; the tool counts them separately from "confirmed fault" to remind buyers to reserve repair uncertainty; confirmed faults can be directly deducted from pricing.
map.电器测试建议在发动机运转状态下进行，确保供电正常: Electrical testing is advised with the engine running to ensure normal power supply
map.间歇故障可能是线束接触不良或模块问题，需进一步诊断: Intermittent faults may be wire-harness contact issues or module problems and need further diagnosis
map.蓄电池电压参考：熄火≥12.4V正常，启动后13.8-14.4V为充电正常: Battery voltage reference: off ≥12.4V normal, running 13.8–14.4V means charging normal
